admission.justification: Spans task_doc_review_target.py and task_doc_tools.py, is guarded by three regression tests, and prevents omitted-slug review calls from silently mutating master task.json or task_doc.create from persisting mismatched slug or repo fields.

applicability: task_doc begin_review, record_review, and create calls dispatched through application/task_docs/task_doc_tools.py.
conditions: A leaf contract is active, the caller holds a leaf-bound seat, or the task folder contains sibling leaf JSON documents.
exclusions: record_route_review, which preserves atomic-master series targeting without a leaf slug, and genuine master-level reviews passed with explicit slug='task' outside leaf contexts.
statement: begin_review and record_review refuse an omitted slug when sibling leaf task documents exist and refuse slug mismatch against leaf contracts or bindings with zero writes to master task.json, while record_route_review preserves atomic-master targeting.
title: begin_review and record_review require explicit leaf slug and guard create
